changelog: **Product-usage signals and the account usage chart** (#2449, #2448). The rule is `src/lib/usageRule.ts` (pure, `scripts/test/usage-rule.test.mjs`), the queries `src/lib/usageSignals.ts`. The attention queue gains `usage_drop` (the last half of a `usageBaselineDays` window — default 60 — at least `usageDropThresholdPct`, default 40 %, below the half before it) and `trial_inactive` (a `TRIAL_ACTIVE` record with no usage at all `trialActivationDays`, default 7, after `trialStartedAt`); both are in `SALES_ATTENTION_REASONS`, only show and never move a stage. Its footnote counts the caller's accounts left out for too short a history, the org's dropping accounts with no active owner, and says when no usage feed has delivered anything yet. The account page (`/admin/companies/[id]`, `/sales/accounts/[id]`) charts the last 90 days of `CompanyUsage` in the house CSS-bar style (`UsageSparkline`), with a recorded zero and a missing day drawn and summarised differently. Both stay dark until the SaleVali usage feed (#2447) writes rows.

en: Once product usage flows in, accounts whose usage drops and trials nobody has started using show up in your attention queue, and each account page charts its last 90 days.
tr: Ürün kullanım verisi gelmeye başladığında, kullanımı düşen hesaplar ve kimsenin kullanmaya başlamadığı denemeler dikkat kuyruğunuzda görünür; her hesap sayfası son 90 günü grafikle gösterir.
de: Sobald Nutzungsdaten eintreffen, erscheinen Accounts mit sinkender Nutzung und ungenutzte Testphasen in Ihrer Aufmerksamkeitsliste, und jede Account-Seite zeigt die letzten 90 Tage als Diagramm.
